# Photopolymerization_Printing

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-23

## Definition
A 3D printing technique that uses light to cure liquid polymer resins into solid structures layer by layer. Enables high-resolution, rapid fabrication of micro-scale components that could be used to prototype neuromorphic or topological hardware.
